author: levelsio
text:
💧 For years I was brought up in the Netherlands being told we had the "best tap water in the world"

"The Americans are silly for buying bottles of mineral water, you can just drink from the tap!"

I remember the same sentiment with my German friends

When I stayed at the VOCO hotel in The Hague a few months ago, there were no water bottles but a paper note saying "Do like the locals do! Drink from the tap"

Now it turns out Dutch tap water is and probably was full of toxic chemicals and plastics

Today actually we finally installed a Reverse Osmosis (RO) system in our home (or well the plumber did) by Waterdrop (unaffiliated, unpaid, recommended by Claude)

RO seems to the best and most pure water filtration system out there

I will let you know how the coffee tastes tomorrow with it! 😋
